statements.impact_statement: Expires: 2026-12-02. Surface: pagespeed/system/console/pnpm-lock.yaml only; path @pagespeed/admin-console (devDependencies) -> vite-plugin-singlefile@2.3.0 -> micromatch@4.0.8 -> braces ^3.0.3; no other consumer in the lockfile, and the shipped bundle admin_console.html contains no braces/micromatch code (build-time tooling only, run on developer and CI machines against a committed source tree). No fix exists: 3.0.3 is the latest braces release, the advisory range is <= 3.0.3 with first_patched_version null, micromatch@4.0.8 (latest) pins braces ^3.0.3, and the upstream fix (micromatch/braces PR #72 for issue #70) is open and unmerged with no maintainer commit since 2025-01-19. The vulnerable path is braces' recursive AST walkers (lib/parse.js, lib/compile.js, lib/expand.js) overflowing the call stack on a deeply nested brace PATTERN. In micromatch, braces() is reached only from micromatch.parse / micromatch.braces / micromatch.braceExpand; micromatch.isMatch — the single micromatch call in vite-plugin-singlefile (dist/esm/index.js) — goes straight to picomatch and never calls braces. That isMatch call is itself guarded by inlinePattern.length, and the console's vite.config.ts calls viteSingleFile() with no options, so inlinePattern is [] and micromatch is never invoked at all during the build. Even on the hypothetical path the only input braces would ever see is the inlinePattern glob authored in vite.config.ts, never request data or any attacker-controlled string. Re-evaluate on expiry, when vite-plugin-singlefile changes its micromatch usage or drops it, or when a patched braces (> 3.0.3) / micromatch is published (then bump via a pnpm override instead of extending this statement).

Fixed in nginx 1.30.3 (and 1.31.2). The bundled matched-pair nginx IS 1.30.6 — later on the 1.30 stable branch than the 1.30.3 release that carries the fix. grype false-positive: the NVD CPE range (>= 1.13.10, < 1.31.2) sweeps the entire 1.30.x branch and does not carve out the 1.30.x backport. Re-evaluate/update the pinned version when the bundled nginx (DEF_NGINX_VER, focal path in install/nginx/build_module_in_container.sh) is next bumped.

Fixed in nginx 1.30.3 (and 1.31.2). The bundled matched-pair nginx IS 1.30.6, which succeeds 1.30.3 on the 1.30 stable branch. grype false-positive: the NVD CPE range (< 1.31.2) does not carve out the 1.30.x backport. Re-evaluate the pinned version on the next bundled-nginx bump.

Expires: 2027-02-01. Surface: test/browser/hydration/nuxt-app/package-lock.json only, a test fixture that ships in no package or image. The fixture is built with `nuxt generate` (test/browser/hydration/build_all.sh) and only its static output (.output/public) is served, by Apache or nginx in the hydration browser check; no Nuxt or Nitro server runs at any point. The advisory needs server islands (a .server.vue component or page, or <NuxtIsland> with experimental.componentIslands) that call useHeadSafe with user-controlled input; the fixture (app.vue, nuxt.config.ts) has no server component, no NuxtIsland, does not enable componentIslands and never calls useHeadSafe. The fix is only in nuxt 4.6.2, a major update of the fixture. Re-evaluate on expiry or when the fixture moves to Nuxt 4, whichever comes first; at that update take the fixed version instead of extending this statement.

Expires: 2027-02-01. Surface: test/browser/hydration/nuxt-app/package-lock.json only, a test fixture that ships in no package or image. The fixture is built with `nuxt generate` (test/browser/hydration/build_all.sh) and only its static output (.output/public) is served, by Apache or nginx in the hydration browser check; no Nuxt or Nitro server runs at any point. The advisory is about server-side route rules (redirect, headers, proxy, ssr, noScripts) skipped for case-variant paths by the Nitro server; the fixture's nuxt.config.ts defines no routeRules, and with no server at runtime no route rule is resolved. No fix exists on the 3.x line (fixed in nuxt and @nuxt/nitro-server 4.6.2). Re-evaluate on expiry or when the fixture moves to Nuxt 4, whichever comes first; at that update take the fixed version instead of extending this statement.

Expires: 2027-02-01. Surface: test/browser/hydration/nuxt-app/package-lock.json only, a test fixture that ships in no package or image. The fixture is built with `nuxt generate` (test/browser/hydration/build_all.sh, also called by run_module_check.sh) and only its static output (.output/public) is served, by Apache or nginx in the hydration browser check; no Nuxt or Nitro server, and no Nuxt dev server, runs at any point. glob is pulled in only by Nuxt's build dependencies (@vercel/nft and archiver-utils) and runs inside the fixture build on paths and patterns fixed by those tools and the fixture's own project; it never sees a request or a request-supplied path or pattern, so the advisory's post-timeout traversal has nothing untrusted to reach. The fix (14.0.2) is outside the ranges these Nuxt 3 dependencies accept (glob ^13.0.0 and ^10.0.0). Re-evaluate on expiry or when the fixture moves to Nuxt 4, whichever comes first; at that update take the fixed version instead of extending this statement.

Expires: 2027-02-01. Surface: test/browser/hydration/nuxt-app/package-lock.json only, a test fixture that ships in no package or image. The fixture is built with `nuxt generate` (test/browser/hydration/build_all.sh, also called by run_module_check.sh) and only its static output (.output/public) is served, by Apache or nginx in the hydration browser check; no Nuxt or Nitro server, and no Nuxt dev server, runs at any point. minimatch is pulled in only through glob and readdir-glob in Nuxt's build dependencies and runs inside the fixture build on paths and patterns fixed by those tools and the fixture's own project; it never sees a request or a request-supplied pattern, so the advisory's pattern amplification cannot be triggered. The fix (11.0.1) is outside the ranges these Nuxt 3 dependencies accept (minimatch ^10.2.2, ^9.0.4 and ^5.1.0). Re-evaluate on expiry or when the fixture moves to Nuxt 4, whichever comes first; at that update take the fixed version instead of extending this statement.

Expires: 2027-02-01. Surface: test/browser/hydration/nuxt-app/package-lock.json only, a test fixture that ships in no package or image. The fixture is built with `nuxt generate` (test/browser/hydration/build_all.sh, also called by run_module_check.sh) and only its static output (.output/public) is served, by Apache or nginx in the hydration browser check; no Nuxt or Nitro server, and no Nuxt dev server, runs at any point. The advisory needs the Vite dev server started by `nuxt dev`, which serves the Nitro development bundle and the private runtime config inlined in it; production builds are not affected. The fixture is only ever built with `nuxt generate`, never started with `nuxt dev`, and its nuxt.config.ts defines no runtimeConfig. The fix is only in @nuxt/vite-builder 4.6.3, a major update of the fixture. Re-evaluate on expiry or when the fixture moves to Nuxt 4, whichever comes first; at that update take the fixed version instead of extending this statement.
